articles.title: Vihara House / Di Frenna Arquitectos
english: Vihara House, completed in 2025 by Di Frenna Arquitectos, is a striking representation of nature-integrated architecture. Located in Tankah Pueblo, Mexico, its design harmonizes with the surrounding environment. Here, life is centered around water, and the natural light filters through the branches of trees, creating a tranquil living space.

The architects aimed to harmonize the structure with the landscape, allowing vegetation to shape not just aesthetics but also functionality. This approach promotes a unique relationship between indoor and outdoor spaces. The air's movement is influenced by the arrangement of plant life, enhancing the home's comfort and ecological health.

Sustainability was a key focus in the design of Vihara House. By utilizing local materials and creating a low-impact footprint, the architects respect the natural habitat while providing a modern living experience. This project exemplifies how thoughtful architecture can foster a deeper connection to nature.
chinese: Vihara House 由 Di Frenna Arquitectos 設計，於 2025 年落成，是一個與自然融為一體的建築瑰寶。位於墨西哥的 Tankah Pueblo，該設計與周圍環境協調一致。在這裡，生活圍繞著水，陽光透過樹枝濾入，創造出一個寧靜的生活空間。
建築師力求使結構與景觀和諧，讓植物不僅塑造美學，還增強其功能性。這種方法促進了室內與室外空間之間獨特的關係。空氣的流動受到植物擺放的影響，使家居的舒適性和生態健康得到提升。
可持續性是 Vihara House 設計的核心重點。通過利用當地材料並創造低影響的腳印，建築師在尊重自然棲息地的同時，也提供了現代的居住體驗。這個項目展示了深思熟慮的建築如何促進與自然的更深聯繫。

articles.title: Six Frank Lloyd Wright restoration projects across the US
english: Following the completion of the recent renovations at Frank Lloyd Wright's Fallingwater house, various groups continue to preserve his architectural legacy. Organizations like the Frank Lloyd Wright Building Conservancy work diligently to maintain and protect his works throughout the United States. This includes ongoing restoration projects and the logistics of transporting significant buildings across state lines.

One notable project is the refurbishment of the J Willis Hughes House in Mississippi, recently acquired by the Mississippi Museum of Art. This initiative aims to update the house for visitor exploration, inspired by the success of other museums showcasing Wright's properties.

In Wisconsin, the Hillside Theatre on Wright's Taliesin estate has been reopened after a five-year refurbishment that addressed structural issues and upgraded facilities. Such efforts exemplify the commitment to keeping Wright's architectural contributions alive for future generations.
chinese: 隨著近年來弗蘭克·勞埃德·賴特的Fallingwater住宅翻修工作的完成，許多團體持續努力保存他的建築遺產。像是賴特建築保護協會這樣的組織，致力於在美國各地維護和保護他的作品。這包括正在進行的修復項目，以及跨州搬遷重要建築的後勤工作。
一個值得注意的項目是密西西比州的J Willis Hughes House，這座房子最近由密西西比美術館收購。該計劃旨在更新房子以供遊客參觀，靈感來自於其他博物館展示賴特作品的成功。
在威斯康星州，賴特的Taliesin莊園內的Hillside Theatre在經過五年的翻修後重新開放，這次翻修解決了結構問題並升級了設施。這些努力體現了保持賴特建築貢獻活力的承諾，讓未來世代能夠欣賞。

articles.topic: Wasl Tower: A Twisting Architectural Marvel in Dubai
articles.title: UNS’s newly completed wasl tower leans into a twisting contrapposto stance over dubai
english: The Wasl Tower, designed by UNS, stands out at 302 meters along Sheikh Zayed Road in Dubai. Its sinuous shape offers a unique silhouette that changes from different perspectives, appearing narrow from afar while revealing a layered form up close. The ceramic fins on its facade reflect a contemporary response to environmental factors, providing shading and allowing daylight to filter through.

The building's innovative ceramic facade is not merely decorative; it serves as an environmental system. Thousands of terracotta fins wrap around the structure, optimizing air movement and reducing heat gain through thoughtful placement, which ultimately decreases reliance on mechanical cooling methods. This integration of tradition with modern techniques enhances both performance and durability, focusing on sustainability.

Inside, the Wasl Tower functions as a mixed-use vertical city, combining hotel, residential, and office spaces. Public areas are spread throughout various levels, encouraging social interaction and movement within the building. The interior showcases polished stone floors and filtered daylight, creating a serene atmosphere while maximizing outward views, reflecting a holistic approach to architectural design.
chinese: Wasl 塔由 UNS 設計，位於迪拜的謝赫扎耶德路上，矗立在 302 米的高度，十分搶眼。它的蜿蜒形狀提供了獨特的輪廓，從不同的角度看會展現出變化，遠觀時顯得狹窄，近看則揭示出層次分明的形態。其外立面的陶瓷細條充分反映出對環境因素的現代回應，提供遮陽，同時讓自然光透入。
這座建築的創新陶瓷外立面並不僅僅是裝飾；它起著環境系統的作用。數以千計的陶土細條環繞著結構，通過精心的佈置優化空氣流動，減少熱量的吸收，進而降低對機械冷卻方式的依賴。將傳統與現代技術融合，提升了建築的性能和耐用性，重點關注可持續性。
在 Wasl 塔內部，功能如同一座混合用途的垂直城市，結合酒店、住宅和辦公空間。公共區域分布在不同的樓層，鼓勵建筑內的社交互動與流動。室內展示了光滑的石材地板與過濾的自然光，塑造出平靜的氛圍，同時最大化外部視野，反映出整體的建築設計思維。
